requirements.zh-Hans: 维护者与库作者：500+ 依赖仓库、100+ 依赖包或 200,000+ 每月下载量；核心贡献者：知名基金会或语言项目成员；活跃贡献者：过去 12 个月有 100+ PR 合并；社区建设者：你的仓库在过去 12 个月有 20+ 外部贡献者；关键基础设施：OpenSSF 关键性评分 0.4 以上
requirements.en: Maintainers & library authors: 500+ dependent repos, 100+ dependent packages, or 200,000+ monthly downloads; Core contributors: listed on recognized foundation or language project; Active contributors: 100+ PRs merged in last 12 months; Community builders: 20+ unique external contributors in last 12 months; Critical infrastructure: OpenSSF criticality score 0.4+
